title: 45-MIN FOUNDATION — WEEK 3 DAY 19
additionalTitle: BODYLINE + NECK/SPINE/LOWER-LEG DURABILITY + BALANCE + AEROBIC BASE

levels.bonus: Optional 5–10 min relaxed supine breathing only. BJJ: Ignition + A×2/B×1/D×1 (18:50), or skip if class/time load is high.

ignition.name: Zone-2 Treadmill
ignition.cue: RPE 4; short comfortable stride. Stop if thigh or knee pain rises.

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: BODYLINE — PLANCHE WITHHELD
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RPE 5, 5 RIR. Planche rung foundation; NONE VERIFIED. Bodyline adjunct only; gate remains two user-confirmed clean 3×6–8 pseudo-planche push-up exposures.

exercises.name: McGill Curl-Up
exercises.cue: Brace; lift only head/shoulders; use a comfortable knee angle and skip if symptoms reproduce

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: ADAPTED NECK DURABILITY — UPPER WITHHELD
deposits.effort: Rest 1:30; RPE 4, 5 RIR. Compound pull/press withheld and not credited; NONE VERIFIED. Deliberate low-fatigue corrective repeat; no progression.

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: SPINE + LOWER-LEG DURABILITY — SQUAT WITHHELD
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RPE 4–5, 5 RIR. Loaded squat withheld and not credited. Calf rung two-leg bodyweight; NONE VERIFIED; no progression.

exercises.name: Segmental Cat-Cow
exercises.cue: Move slowly; pad or skip kneeling if the knee objects

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Pause high and low; knees soft, not deeply bent

media.sourceName: Kar Weng | Physiotherapist for Healthy Aging

deposits.label: D
deposits.title: BALANCE + HIP CONTROL — POWER WITHHELD
deposits.effort: Rest 1:30; RPE 4, 5 RIR. Lower-body power withheld and not credited; displayed 2026-09-26 balance task repeated without progression.

exercises.name: Supported Hip Airplane
exercises.cue: Small pain-free hip rotation; almost-straight stance knee

deposits.label: E
deposits.title: RECOVERY ENGINE
deposits.effort: 8:00 continuous; RPE 4–5. Deliberate symptom-limited aerobic repeat; no benchmark credit without user-confirmed pain-free completion.

exercises.name: Zone-2 Treadmill
exercises.cue: Smooth posture; stop if symptoms increase

martialSupplement.name: Technical-Stand-Up Visualization
martialSupplement.home: Watch exact demo; mentally rehearse only—no physical drilling
martialSupplement.cue: Separate; no reps while shoulder and thigh/knee symptoms remain unresolved; never auto-log
